title: A Conditional Reduction for Algebraic Kuga–Satake Correspondences

abstractEnglish: For a polarized K3 surface whose primitive cohomology has full orthogonal Hodge group, one algebraic correspondence inducing a nonzero map from that cohomology to the second cohomology of an abelian variety suffices to recover the prescribed full Kuga–Satake correspondence. We give an equivalent condition using holomorphic one-forms on a generically finite surface cover. If this input holds very generally in a polarized component, the prescribed correspondence is algebraic throughout that component, for every choice of standard data on the transcendental part. The existence of the initial correspondence remains a hypothesis.
titleEn: A Conditional Reduction for Algebraic Kuga–Satake Correspondences
titleZh: 代数 Kuga–Satake 对应的一个条件性归约

details.overview: 稿件研究极化 K3 曲面的 Kuga–Satake 对应代数性。作者考虑本原上同调具有完整正交 Hodge 群的 K3 曲面，声称只要存在一个代数对应，从该上同调诱导非零映射到某阿贝尔簇第二上同调，就能恢复指定的完整 Kuga–Satake 对应；并给出用一般有限曲面覆盖上全纯 1-形式的等价条件。若该输入在极化分支中很一般地成立，则指定对应在整个分支上代数，且对超越部分标准数据的任意选择成立。初始对应的存在性仍是假设。
keyPoints: 以单个非零代数对应为输入恢复完整 Kuga–Satake 对应
给出基于全纯 1-形式的等价条件
初始对应存在性仍为假设，结论有条件
